notes: Company background: mid-market SaaS (vertical: marketing analytics) with product-led growth motion. Heavy docs + chat workflows for SMB customers.
Current architecture: main product in GCP (us-west1). Looking to move inference to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower per-token cost.

Targets: latency p50 < 60ms for simple completions, p95 < 120ms for chat; embedding throughput 10k/s for nightly job; cost sensitivity high — target 30-45% cost reduction vs hosted at scale.
